question: Prepare a comprehensive performance report on our sellers, focusing on total sales, average item price, average review scores, and packing times. Ensure that the report includes only those sellers who have sold a quantity of more than 100 products and highlight the product category names in English with the highest sales volume.
sql:
SELECT 
    'seller' as report_type,
    seller_id,
    total_quantity,
    avg_item_price,
    avg_review_score,
    avg_packing_time_hours
FROM (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        COUNT(*) as total_quantity,
        ROUND(AVG(oi.price), 2) as avg_item_price,
        ROUND(AVG(r.review_score), 2) as avg_review_score,
        ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (CAST(oi.shipping_limit_date AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP))) / 3600), 2) as avg_packing_time_hours
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    LEFT JOIN order_reviews r ON oi.order_id = r.order_id
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 100
    ORDER BY total_quantity DESC
) sellers
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'top_category' as report_type,
    NULL as seller_id,
    sales_volume as total_quantity,
    NULL as avg_item_price,
    NULL as avg_review_score,
    product_category_name_english as avg_packing_time_hours
FROM (
    SELECT 
        ptc.product_category_name_english,
        COUNT(*) as sales_volume
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN product_category_name_translation ptc ON p.product_category_name = ptc.product_category_name
    GROUP BY ptc.product_category_name_english
    ORDER BY sales_volume DESC
    LIMIT 1
) top_category
ORDER BY report_type, total_quantity DESC NULLS LAST
